AN IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT

New management. A renewed mission.

Mirror Lake is under new management, with a renewed commitment to our Christ-centered mission. Our vision is to provide a welcoming place where churches, ministries, families, and Christian organizations can gather, grow in faith, build meaningful relationships, and experience the beauty of God’s creation.

As part of this renewed direction, effective January 1, 2027, Mirror Lake will transition to serving registered groups and ministry-related gatherings rather than operating as a facility open to the general public.

WELCOME TO MIRROR LAKE

Unplug a little.
Feel a little closer.

Tucked into the Hudson Valley, a world of fresh air, still water, and simple pleasures is waiting for you.

For more than 50 years, this special corner of New York has brought people together. Today, our reimagined retreat pairs the beauty of the outdoors with comfortable places to stay. Come as a family, gather your group, or simply make room for a slower weekend.
